approved_scope.description: Size the checkpoint from measured use: a 1 MiB cap with at-cap budgets, session shelve, and sessions that never break each other (DRIVE-14, 125)
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: DRIVE-14 (Leif: 1 MiB from the sizing study, Add shelve, 2026-11-05): REQ-cli-032 cap and budgets, REQ-cli-021 stress shape (C3, #125), REQ-history-006 shelve and per-session robustness.
acceptance_criteria: Every checkpoint is bounded at 1,048,576 bytes; at the cap next, status and context answer within 2 s in the debug test build (250 ms release) with the focused view within 16,384 bytes; one byte over is refused naming the cap and chough session shelve; chough session shelve <key> and --legacy move the oversized checkpoint byte for byte into .chough/sessions/shelved/ so session new and next work; one unreadable session never breaks list, new, use or another session next; retention reads shelved sessions; REQ-cli-021 AC1 holds 40 gates, 40 blockers and 50 decisions of 4 KiB within the cap. The new tests fail first and fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: DRIVE-14, DRIVE-13 (captured 2026-11-05 in Leif words, relayed by orc); Leif chose 1 MiB (20:08 MST) and Add shelve (20:12 MST); 16 KiB focused view unchanged; KNOW-29 separate.
